name: Active Search Results

sources.title: Active Search Results - Add Your WebSite
Active Search Results - indexing schedule page (linked from submission form)
Active Search Results - About ASR / ranking activity points

requirements: Only a valid URL and a valid email address are required - the form explicitly states 'No sign in or activation process is required'
Open submission: the form accepts both POST and GET requests with field names 'url' and 'email' (documented for search-engine submission companies)
preparation: The full URL to submit (e.g. https://www.example.com/mypage.html)
Optional: check the Schedule page (/help/indexschedule.php) for the current index-update timing
workflow: Enter the website URL in the 'Web Site Address' field and a valid email in 'Email'
Submit the form - no account, login, or activation step exists
Check the Schedule page to see when the site will be searchable in the index
watchFor: This is a search-engine index submission, not a guaranteed permanent listing - inclusion follows ASR's crawl/index schedule
ASR ranking is activity-based (see 'How To Earn a Higher ASR Ranking'); a bare submission may rank poorly
Do not assume indexing equals a followed backlink - verify the live listing separately
countsAsLive: The submitted URL is returned as a result when searched on activesearchresults.com after the published index-update schedule has elapsed
unknowns: Exact lag between submission and index inclusion (published on the Schedule page but not captured verbatim)
Whether any paid tier affects ranking or indexing speed
Whether the listing link is dofollow on live result pages
